content: bcrypt silently truncates/ignores password bytes beyond 72 bytes (and historically truncates at the first NUL byte); passlib+bcrypt 5.0.0 currently has a known breakage (__about__ attribute removed) causing false 72-byte errors even for short passwords -- another reason to avoid passlib+raw bcrypt pairing. argon2 (via pwdlib/argon2-cffi) has no such length ceiling.
